FINDING: app/auth.py:14 | SQL injection: `name` is interpolated into the query with an f-string. Use a `?` parameter instead.
FINDING: app/auth.py:5 | Hardcoded signing secret in source. Load it from the environment or a secrets store.
FINDING: app/auth.py:21 | The password salt is the username, so it is predictable and not random per user. The same applies at line 30. Use a random per-user salt and store it.
FINDING: app/auth.py:35 | The token is an HMAC of the user_id only, with no expiry or nonce. It never expires and can't be revoked.
FINDING: app/files.py:10 | Path traversal in `export_report`: `filename` is not sanitized, so `../` or an absolute path can write outside EXPORT_DIR. `read_report` uses `basename`, but this function doesn't.
FINDING: app/orders.py:13 | The docstring says $100.00 or more gets the discount, but `>` excludes exactly 10,000 cents. It should be `>=`.
FINDING: app/orders.py:23 | The docstring says tax is charged on the discounted amount, but the code taxes the undiscounted `subtotal`. It should use `discounted`.
FINDING: app/orders.py:58 | Stock is checked per line, so duplicate SKUs in a cart can each pass the check and then oversell when reserved.
FINDING: app/orders.py:62 | The return value of `reserve()` is ignored. `reserve` also commits per call, so a failure partway leaves partial reservations and no order. The whole placement needs a single transaction.
FINDING: app/inventory.py:10 | Off-by-one in `paginate`: the slice `start + page_size - 1` returns only page_size-1 items per page, so one item is skipped per page.
